answer:
The Office for National Statistics (ONS) “Domestic gas consumption” indicator gives median domestic gas consumption (kWh per meter point) for each authority in 2012 and 2023.  
The difference (drop) for the five authorities is:

| Authority | 2012 median (kWh) | 2023 median (kWh) | Drop (kWh) |
|-----------|------------------|-------------------|------------|
| Flintshire | 12,571.0 | 9,289.3 | **3,281.7** |
| County Durham | 13,681.0 | 10,636.2 | 3,044.8 |
| Bedford | 12,713.0 | 9,960.1 | 2,752.9 |
| North Lincolnshire | 13,031.0 | 10,054.2 | 2,976.8 |
| Telford & Wrekin | 11,879.0 | 9,101.0 | 2,778.0 |

**The largest drop is in Flintshire, with a reduction of 3,281.7 kWh.**

Source: ONS “Domestic gas consumption” indicator, accessed via the local‑statistics page and the API that provided the values for 2012 and 2023.
